purpose: Baseline-only qualification for a potential separately reviewed exact iterator-B replication.
runner: Dedicated Intel Sapphire Rapids; no current lease
hypothesis: A separately qualified, documented controlled environment and corrected-source build can resolve the original 1% guard threshold. This is unproven; no causal noise remedy is claimed.
pairing: First and fourth versus second and third; all are the SAME baseline binary.

calibration.count_rule: ceil(initial_visits * target_seconds / fastest_elapsed_seconds); freeze all counts before A/A; no cap clipping or recalibration

gate.precision: abs(inner_sum - outer_sum)*100 <= outer_sum in every block
gate.outputs: Exact fixture/checksum/operation and tree-owned memory equality
gate.failure: Complete and retain the fixed schedule within the cap. Any failure or timeout keeps PARK; no retry, extension, row deletion or candidate launch.

phase_order: Reserve and document a genuinely new controlled measurement condition; unchanged failed retries are ineligible.
Reconstruct exact baseline/retained candidate in separate builds. Run original and additive correctness/fault checks; refresh baseline codegen/profile. No candidate timings.
Seal compiler, flags, binary/referee/source hashes, cells/seeds, schedule, baseline-only calibration/counts and deadline; independent pre-execution review.
Run the fixed baseline-only qualification serially.
Only if all prerequisites pass, prepare and review a distinct exact-B comparison with complete guard, confirmation and matched-profile plans.
unresolved_before_execution: Exact new condition that distinguishes this from an unchanged failed run
Compiler/flags, fresh binary/profile and correctness identities
Per-cell calibration counts and wall-clock deadline
